_note: Generated from docs/research/14-ai-roles-concept-map.html. levels: 2 = core, 1 = good to know, 0 = not needed for that role.

roles.title: ML Engineer
roles.description: Builds, trains and ships models into production systems.

roles.title: GenAI / LLM Engineer
roles.description: Builds products on foundation models: prompting, RAG, agents, fine-tuning and evals.

roles.title: AI Platform / MLOps
roles.description: Runs the infrastructure that trains, deploys and monitors models reliably.

roles.title: AI / ML Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds the pipelines and datasets that models learn from and serve on.

roles.title: Data / Applied Scientist
roles.description: Turns data into decisions and models through statistics, experiments and research.

roles.title: AI Backend / SWE
roles.description: Integrates AI into product backends: APIs, LLM calls, retrieval and reliability.

roles.title: AI Architect / Lead
roles.description: Designs end-to-end AI systems and guides teams on cost, risk and strategy.

concepts.title: Linear Algebra
concepts.description: Vectors, matrices and the operations on them. Model parameters, embeddings and data batches are all matrices, so this is the language ML is written in.
concepts.practiceProject: Implement PCA from scratch with NumPy using SVD and compare it with scikit-learn.

concepts.title: Calculus
concepts.description: Derivatives, partial derivatives and the chain rule. Backpropagation is the chain rule applied to a computation graph.
concepts.practiceProject: Hand-derive the gradient of the logistic regression loss, then check it numerically.

concepts.title: Probability
concepts.description: Random variables, distributions and expectation. Models output probabilities, and most losses are built from likelihoods.
concepts.practiceProject: Simulate a naive Bayes spam filter on a small email dataset.

concepts.title: Statistical Inference
concepts.description: Drawing conclusions from samples: estimates, uncertainty and tests. It tells you whether a metric change is real or noise.
concepts.practiceProject: Bootstrap confidence intervals for a model's accuracy on a held-out set.

concepts.title: A/B Testing
concepts.description: Designing controlled experiments to measure the impact of a change on real users. The final word on whether a model ships.
concepts.practiceProject: Write an experiment plan for a new ranking model, including sample size and stopping rules.

concepts.title: Optimization
concepts.description: How models find good parameters: gradient descent and its variants. Explains learning rates, schedules and why training diverges.
concepts.practiceProject: Train linear regression with your own SGD and plot loss curves for three learning rates.

concepts.title: Causal Inference
concepts.description: Estimating cause and effect when you cannot run an experiment. Used for pricing, policy and uplift questions.
concepts.practiceProject: Estimate the effect of a promotion from observational data using difference-in-differences.

concepts.title: Python
concepts.description: The working language of AI. Every one of the seven roles reads and writes it daily.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a small CLI tool with typed functions, a test suite and a pyproject.toml.

concepts.title: Git & Linux CLI
concepts.description: Version control, the shell and remote machines. You will spend real time in a terminal on GPU boxes and CI runners.
concepts.practiceProject: Automate a data download and cleanup with a shell script and review it through a pull request.

concepts.title: SQL
concepts.description: Querying relational data. Most training data and product metrics start life as a SQL query.
concepts.practiceProject: Answer ten product questions on a public dataset using window functions.

concepts.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
concepts.description: Complexity, core data structures and classic algorithms. Needed to write code that scales, and to pass interviews.
concepts.practiceProject: Implement an LRU cache and a top-k heap, with tests and complexity notes.

concepts.title: NumPy & Pandas
concepts.description: Vectorised numerical computing and tabular data wrangling in Python.
concepts.practiceProject: Clean and profile a messy one-million-row CSV without Python loops.

concepts.title: Testing & Code Quality
concepts.description: Unit, integration and data tests, plus linting and review habits that keep ML code maintainable.
concepts.practiceProject: Add tests and a linter to an existing notebook-turned-script.

concepts.title: APIs & Web Services
concepts.description: Designing and building HTTP APIs. Models and LLM features reach users through them.
concepts.practiceProject: Wrap a trained model in a FastAPI service with request validation and health checks.

concepts.title: Concurrency & Async
concepts.description: Running many things at once with threads, processes and async IO. LLM apps spend most of their time waiting on network calls.
concepts.practiceProject: Call an LLM API for 1,000 prompts concurrently with a rate limiter and retries.

concepts.title: System Design
concepts.description: Designing services that are scalable, reliable and maintainable: caching, queues, databases and their trade-offs.
concepts.practiceProject: Design a URL shortener, then a notification service, and write up the trade-offs.

concepts.title: Data Modeling & Warehousing
concepts.description: Structuring data for analytics and ML with schemas, warehouses and lakehouses.
concepts.practiceProject: Model an e-commerce dataset as a star schema in DuckDB.

concepts.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
concepts.description: Profiling and visualising data to find patterns, errors and leakage before modelling.
concepts.practiceProject: Publish a short EDA notebook on a public dataset with five clear findings.

concepts.title: Pipelines & Orchestration
concepts.description: Moving and transforming data on a schedule, reliably, with tools like Airflow, Dagster and dbt.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a daily pipeline that ingests an API, transforms with dbt and loads a warehouse.

concepts.title: Distributed Processing
concepts.description: Processing data that does not fit on one machine with Spark, Dask or Ray Data.
concepts.practiceProject: Compute features over a 50 GB dataset with PySpark and profile the slowest stage.

concepts.title: Streaming Data
concepts.description: Handling events in real time with Kafka, Flink or similar, for fresh features and online systems.
concepts.practiceProject: Stream clickstream events through Kafka and compute rolling five-minute counts.

concepts.title: Data Quality & Contracts
concepts.description: Validating data before it breaks a model, with tests, expectations and contracts between teams.
concepts.practiceProject: Add validation checks to your pipeline that fail the run on bad data.

concepts.title: Feature Engineering
concepts.description: Turning raw data into model inputs, and serving the same features in training and in production.
concepts.practiceProject: Build time-correct features for a churn model and serve them from Feast.

concepts.title: Dataset Curation
concepts.description: Collecting, labelling and cleaning training and evaluation data. Better data usually beats a better model.
concepts.practiceProject: Write labelling guidelines for 200 examples, label them and measure agreement.

concepts.title: Data Governance & Privacy
concepts.description: Knowing what data you have, where it came from and who may use it. Covers PII, lineage and regulation.
concepts.practiceProject: Trace one ML feature from source to model and flag every PII field on the way.

concepts.title: ML Fundamentals
concepts.description: The core ideas behind learning from data: generalisation, overfitting and how to split data honestly.
concepts.practiceProject: Show overfitting on a small dataset and fix it with regularisation and cross-validation.

concepts.title: Supervised Learning
concepts.description: Predicting labels from features with linear models, trees and gradient boosting, still the workhorses on tabular data.
concepts.practiceProject: Beat a logistic-regression baseline with gradient boosting on a tabular dataset.

concepts.title: Unsupervised Learning
concepts.description: Finding structure without labels: clustering, dimensionality reduction and anomaly detection.
concepts.practiceProject: Cluster customer behaviour and explain each segment in plain language.

concepts.title: Model Evaluation
concepts.description: Choosing metrics that match the business goal, and measuring them correctly.
concepts.practiceProject: Pick a threshold for a fraud model from a cost matrix instead of from accuracy.

concepts.title: scikit-learn & XGBoost
concepts.description: The standard libraries for classical ML: pipelines, preprocessing and boosted trees.
concepts.practiceProject: Package a full preprocessing and model pipeline into one saved artefact.

concepts.title: Time Series Forecasting
concepts.description: Forecasting values over time, where order matters and random splits leak the future.
concepts.practiceProject: Forecast daily demand and backtest against a seasonal-naive baseline.

concepts.title: Recommenders & Ranking
concepts.description: Ordering items for a user. Retrieval, ranking and feedback loops sit behind every feed and search box.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a two-stage movie recommender and report NDCG@10.

concepts.title: Neural Networks
concepts.description: Layers, activations and backpropagation: the basis of every modern model.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a tiny autograd engine and train an MLP with it.

concepts.title: PyTorch
concepts.description: The main framework for building and training neural networks.
concepts.practiceProject: Write a clean training loop with checkpointing and validation.

concepts.title: Computer Vision
concepts.description: Convolutional and vision-transformer models for images: classification, detection and segmentation.
concepts.practiceProject: Fine-tune a pretrained image model on a small custom dataset.

concepts.title: Sequence Models & Attention
concepts.description: Modelling ordered data, and the attention mechanism that replaced recurrence.
concepts.practiceProject: Implement scaled dot-product attention and visualise the attention weights.

concepts.title: Embeddings
concepts.description: Dense vectors that capture meaning, so similar things sit close together. They power search, RAG and recommenders.
concepts.practiceProject: Build semantic search over your notes and compare two embedding models.

concepts.title: Transformers
concepts.description: The architecture behind LLMs: self-attention, multi-head attention and stacked residual blocks.
concepts.practiceProject: Train a character-level GPT on a small text corpus.

concepts.title: Training at Scale
concepts.description: Training large models efficiently across GPUs: numeric precision, parallelism and memory.
concepts.practiceProject: Scale a training job from one GPU to four with DDP and measure the speed-up.

concepts.title: Diffusion & Multimodal
concepts.description: Models that generate images, audio and video, and models that read several modalities at once.
concepts.practiceProject: Fine-tune a small diffusion model with LoRA on 20 images.

concepts.title: LLM Fundamentals
concepts.description: How large language models work: tokens, pretraining, context windows, sampling and their failure modes.
concepts.practiceProject: Show a colleague, with a live demo, why the same prompt can give different answers.

concepts.title: Prompt Engineering
concepts.description: Writing instructions, examples and structure that get reliable output from a model.
concepts.practiceProject: Turn a flaky extraction prompt into one that passes 50 test cases.

concepts.title: LLM APIs & SDKs
concepts.description: Calling hosted models in production: tool use, streaming, caching, batching and error handling.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a chat endpoint that streams, calls one tool and caches the system prompt.

concepts.title: Vector Search
concepts.description: Storing and searching embeddings fast, with ANN indexes, metadata filters and hybrid keyword search.
concepts.practiceProject: Index 100k documents in pgvector and compare recall with exact search.

concepts.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
concepts.description: Grounding model answers in your own documents by retrieving relevant context at query time.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a RAG assistant over product docs that cites sources, and measure answer accuracy.

concepts.title: Agents & Tool Use
concepts.description: Letting models plan, call tools and act over many steps, including workflows, MCP and multi-agent patterns.
concepts.practiceProject: Build an agent that triages GitHub issues with two tools and an approval step.

concepts.title: Fine-tuning
concepts.description: Adapting a pretrained model to a task or style with supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods.
concepts.practiceProject: LoRA fine-tune a small open model for a classification task and compare it with prompting.

concepts.title: Preference Tuning
concepts.description: Shaping model behaviour with human or AI feedback through RLHF, DPO and reward models.
concepts.practiceProject: Run DPO on a small preference dataset and evaluate the change.

concepts.title: LLM Evaluation
concepts.description: Measuring whether an LLM system is good, with test sets, graders, LLM-as-judge and regression tracking.
topics: Building eval sets from real traffic
concepts.practiceProject: Create a 100-case eval for your RAG app and run it in CI on every prompt change.

concepts.title: LLM Inference & Serving
concepts.description: Running models fast and cheaply with batching, KV caching, quantisation and serving engines.
concepts.practiceProject: Serve an open model with vLLM and benchmark tokens per second at different batch sizes.

concepts.title: AI Safety & Security
concepts.description: Protecting LLM systems and their users from prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaks and policy violations.
concepts.practiceProject: Red-team your own agent with ten injection attacks and fix what gets through.

concepts.title: Synthetic Data
concepts.description: Using models to generate training and evaluation data, and checking that it actually helps.
concepts.practiceProject: Generate 1,000 synthetic Q&A pairs, filter them and measure the effect on your eval.

concepts.title: Containers
concepts.description: Packaging code and dependencies into images that run the same everywhere.
concepts.practiceProject: Containerise your model API with a slim multi-stage image.

concepts.title: Cloud Platforms
concepts.description: Running workloads on AWS, GCP or Azure: compute, storage, networking and identity.
concepts.practiceProject: Deploy your container to a managed service with a tightly scoped IAM role.

concepts.title: Kubernetes
concepts.description: Orchestrating containers at scale: scheduling, scaling and self-healing.
concepts.practiceProject: Deploy a model service on a local kind cluster with autoscaling.

concepts.title: Infrastructure as Code
concepts.description: Defining infrastructure in version-controlled code so every environment is reproducible.
concepts.practiceProject: Recreate your cloud deployment entirely in Terraform.

concepts.title: CI/CD for ML
concepts.description: Automating tests, builds and deploys, including checks on data and models.
topics: Model and data tests in CI
concepts.practiceProject: Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests, builds and deploys your service.

concepts.title: Experiment Tracking
concepts.description: Recording runs, parameters, metrics and models so results are reproducible and comparable.
concepts.practiceProject: Track 20 training runs and promote the best one through a model registry.

concepts.title: Model Deployment
concepts.description: Getting models to users through batch scoring, online APIs or the edge, with safe rollouts.
concepts.practiceProject: Deploy a model behind an API with a shadow release of a second version.

concepts.title: ML Pipelines
concepts.description: Automating the train, evaluate and deploy loop, including scheduled retraining.
concepts.practiceProject: Build a pipeline that retrains weekly and deploys only if the eval improves.

concepts.title: Monitoring & Observability
concepts.description: Knowing how models behave in production: drift, quality, latency, cost and traces.
concepts.practiceProject: Add tracing and a drift dashboard to a deployed model, and set one alert.

concepts.title: GPU Infrastructure
concepts.description: Provisioning, scheduling and sharing accelerators for training and inference.
concepts.practiceProject: Profile a training job's GPU utilisation and remove one bottleneck.

concepts.title: Cost & Performance
concepts.description: Keeping AI systems fast and affordable through unit economics, caching, right-sizing and model routing.
concepts.practiceProject: Cut the cost of an LLM feature by half without lowering its eval scores.

concepts.title: Technical Communication
concepts.description: Explaining technical work to engineers, product and leadership, in writing and in person.
concepts.practiceProject: Write a one-page design doc for a model you built and get it reviewed.

concepts.title: Problem Framing
concepts.description: Deciding whether ML is the right tool, and turning a business problem into a measurable one.
concepts.practiceProject: Take a vague request and write the problem statement, metric and baseline.

concepts.title: Reading Research
concepts.description: Reading papers critically and turning new results into working experiments.
topics: Reading a paper in three passes
concepts.practiceProject: Reproduce one table from a recent paper and write up what held up.

concepts.title: ML System Design
concepts.description: Designing end-to-end ML systems: data, features, training, serving, feedback and failure modes.
concepts.practiceProject: Design a fraud-detection system end to end and defend it in a mock interview.

concepts.title: GenAI Architecture
concepts.description: Architecting production LLM systems where gateways, routing, caching, fallbacks, evals and guardrails work together.
concepts.practiceProject: Draw the architecture for a company-wide AI assistant, with cost and risk notes.

concepts.title: Responsible AI
concepts.description: Fairness, transparency and compliance, including regulation such as the EU AI Act.
concepts.practiceProject: Write a model card and risk assessment for a system you built.

concepts.title: Build vs Buy
concepts.description: Choosing between hosted APIs, open models, vendors and in-house builds without getting locked in.
concepts.practiceProject: Write a build-vs-buy memo for one AI capability your team needs.

concepts.title: Technical Leadership
concepts.description: Setting direction for AI work through roadmaps, standards, mentoring and aligning teams.
concepts.practiceProject: Run an architecture review of a teammate's design and write the decision record.
